semantics: Replay each case's frames in order with a fresh state. A frame's message (if any) counts as spoken at that frame's time. Box = [x1, y1, x2, y2], fractions of the frame. Expected = every message, with frame index, time, text, priority and cooldown key.

cases.description: Steady stairs ahead and close: spoken once on the 3rd frame, urgent.
A car in 1 of every 5 frames never confirms.
Seen twice in five frames: not confirmed.
Seen 3 times within 5 frames, with gaps: spoken on the 3rd sighting.
An object moving 2% of the frame per frame stays one object.
Same class in a different place every frame (walls as poles): silent.
Normal warning repeats after the 4 s cooldown.
Urgent (ahead + close) warning repeats after 2 s.
While the car is on cooldown, the next riskiest object is spoken.
Center left of 0.333: left.
Center right of 0.667: right.
center_x = (x1 + x2) / 2 compared with < left_boundary.
Far person to the side: risk 0.6 < 1, silent.
Mid distance ahead: normal priority, no 'close'.
Car at 0.44 < 0.45: silent.
Car at 0.46: spoken.
Curb 0.19 (left) silent, curb 0.21 (right) spoken.
Pole whose bottom is above 0.4 and 10% tall: too far, silent.
Bottom above 0.4 but taller than 15%: spoken.
Car 18% tall (low in frame) silent until it grows to 30%.
Hazards-only: the dog is silent, the stairs are spoken.
Hazards-only off: the dog is spoken.
Bench (severity 1) at mid distance to the side: risk 0.6, silent.
Traffic cone at 0.8: its name is spoken.
Traffic cone at 0.55 < 0.6: spoken as Obstacle, warning kept.
Pole at exactly 0.6: name kept (rule is < 0.6).
Cone 0.8 and fire hydrant 0.75 on one object: Obstacle.
A bollard at 0.2 (below its 0.25 speak threshold) doesn't make the pole doubtful.
Cone/hydrant alternate on one object: confirmed as one post, spoken once.
Pole spoken, then the same object at 0.5 (would be Obstacle): same key post:right, no repeat.
